description: This PHP source file defines the class OptimizerNodeVisitor within the Twig templating engine. It implements node visitor logic to perform AST optimizations on Twig templates, including handling 'for' loops and print nodes. The class is an internal component used to improve template rendering efficiency.

classes.name: OptimizerNodeVisitor
classes.description: A final class implementing Twig's NodeVisitorInterface, responsible for optimizing Twig's Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) during template compilation. It manages optimization modes, processes nodes upon entering and leaving, and contains private methods for specific optimizations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the optimizer with the specified mode, validating the mode and setting deprecation notices for certain optimization options.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Processes a node upon entry, applying 'for' loop optimizations if enabled.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Processes a node upon exit, applying 'for' loop optimizations and print node optimizations.

methods.name: optimizePrintNode
methods.description: Optimizes PrintNode nodes, replacing certain print statements with TextNode or Block/ParentExpression nodes for performance improvements.

methods.name: enterOptimizeFor
methods.description: Handles various node types within 'for' loops, managing loop variable creation and recognizing loop references.

methods.name: leaveOptimizeFor
methods.description: Handles cleanup after processing a 'for' node, restoring loop state.

methods.name: addLoopToCurrent
methods.description: Marks the current 'for' loop node as containing a 'with_loop' attribute.

methods.name: addLoopToAll
methods.description: Marks all active loops as containing a 'with_loop' attribute.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority (255) of this node visitor when registered.
